senses.gloss:
ऐतदात्म्यं The state of having
this property or peculiarity.

ऐतरेय a. [इतरा-ठक्] Originating
from Aitareya.
--यः, --यं A
descendant of Itarā (or Itara, a sage)
to whom the Aitareya Brāhmaṇa
and Āraṇyaka were revealed.
--Comp.
--उपनिषद् N. of an
Upanishad.

ऐतरेयिन् m. A reader of the
Aitareya Brāhmaṇa.
